name: ClawForge
description: Enterprise governance layer – SSO authentication, tool policy enforcement, skill approval, audit logging, and kill switch.

controlPlaneUrl.description: Base URL of the ClawForge control plane (e.g. https://clawforge.example.com)

clientId.description: OIDC client ID for the ClawForge application

policyCacheTtlMs.description: Policy cache TTL in milliseconds (default: 3600000 = 1 hour)

heartbeatFailureThreshold.description: Number of consecutive heartbeat failures before degraded mode (default: 10)

auditBatchSize.description: Number of audit events to buffer before shipping (default: 100)

auditFlushIntervalMs.description: Interval for flushing audit events in milliseconds (default: 30000)

offlineMode.description: Behavior when the plugin cannot reach the control plane. 'block' blocks all tools (default), 'allow' allows all tools, 'cached' uses the last cached policy even if stale.

maxAuditBufferSize.description: Maximum number of audit events to buffer before dropping oldest (default: 10000)

sseEnabled.description: Enable real-time SSE connection for instant kill switch and policy updates (default: true)

enabled.description: Enable hourly PR triage / merge automation

dryRun.description: If true, evaluate and notify without merging

minApprovals.description: Minimum approval count required to merge

trustedAuthors.description: GitHub logins allowed for automated merges

githubToken.description: GitHub token with pull-request read + contents write access

slackTarget.description: Slack user or channel id for notifications (for example U123 or C123)
